summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine local bond placement under existing credit lines. The bank placed Series AA-5 bonds for 1,500,000 UF (maturing Feb 2032) at 2.56% and BG Series bonds for CLP 57 billion (maturing Jul 2032) at 6.02%. This is a normal debt issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or corporate event is involved. The filing maps to a Chilean 'Material Fact' and is equivalent to a routine 8-K regarding debt financing.
